'''Divin''' was the first [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] to command [[Ord Antalaha]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The planet's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], [[Fort Divin]], was named after them.
